description: The pie chart represents the distribution of cases without reference answers and test cases across three categories. The chart is divided into three slices, with "Null" being the largest slice, colored red and accounting for approximately 39.2% of the total. The second-largest slice is "Have reference answer," colored blue, making up around 38.9%. The smallest slice is "Have test case," colored green, representing about 21.9%. The chart includes a legend that corresponds to the colors used for each category, and the percentage values are labeled directly on each slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting with "Null," followed by "Have reference answer," and then "Have test case."
